zh-CN.title: 侧边页面可直接打开
items: 菜单设置、聊天详情与用户资料等侧边页面现在支持通过英文链接直接打开，刷新和手势返回也能保持正确层级

en.title: Drawer pages are now linkable
items: Menu settings, chat details, user profiles, and other drawer pages now open directly from stable English links and preserve their navigation stack across refreshes and swipe-back gestures
